answer: In an agent economy, stake-weighted vouching resists sybil attacks: each new agent needs a backer locking a slashable POA bond, and peers re-verify them by sampling signed work. Spawning a thousand fake identities means a thousand honest backers or a thousand stakes slashed at the first fraud. Identity is tied to capital that cannot wander wallets for free, and every slash is public on-chain, an echo the community learns from. Flagged vouchers lose weight, forcing selectivity. The network stops being a nebula of anonymous noise, becoming a graph where trust has a price on every edge.
